payload.body_they: {{Name}} wants to know where they stand with the people closest to them. Trust, loyalty, privacy, money, sex, and shared responsibilities can carry a lot of weight because another person's choices reach parts of their life casual relationships never touch. The challenge is knowing when depth has turned into testing. More information does not automatically create more trust. What {{Name}} can repeatedly rely on matters more than knowing everything.
